name: Aditya Thakur
headline: Full-Stack Developer engineering production-ready monorepos for modern web apps | Backed by 400+ LeetCode solutions
about:
Transitioning from a Computer Science student to an industry-ready Full-Stack Developer, I focus on building scalable architectures and writing maintainable code. Having solved 250+ LeetCode problems, I approach development with a strong foundation in Data Structures, Algorithms, and System Design.

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗜 𝗖𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗔𝗯𝗼𝘂𝘁:
• 𝗦𝗰𝗮𝗹𝗮𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆 & 𝗣𝗲𝗿𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲: Designing APIs that hold up under load and optimizing system bottlenecks.
• 𝗔𝗿𝗰𝗵𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗰𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲: Structuring production-ready applications, leveraging monorepos (Turborepo), and building type-safe ecosystems.
• 𝗠𝗮𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗮𝗶𝗻𝗮𝗯𝗶𝗹𝗶𝘁𝘆: Writing clean, decoupled code that engineers can easily read and scale months down the line.

𝗠𝘆 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵 𝗦𝘁𝗮𝗰𝗸:
• 𝗟𝗮𝗻𝗴𝘂𝗮𝗴𝗲𝘀: C++, JavaScript, TypeScript
• 𝗙𝗿𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝗱: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS
• 𝗕𝗮𝗰𝗸𝗲𝗻𝗱 & 𝗗𝗕: Node.js, Express, tRPC, Drizzle ORM, MongoDB
• 𝗔𝗿𝗰𝗵𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗰𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲: Turborepo, Docker, Kubernetes (Exploring)

I don’t chase shortcuts; I build foundations. I am actively looking for a Full-Stack role where I can contribute to durable systems and continue deepening my engineering expertise.

education.description: Guru Nanak Dev Institute of Technology (GNDIT) is a leading engineering institute in Delhi, affiliated with GGSIPU and recognized by AICTE. Known for its strong industry focus, experienced faculty, and modern facilities, GNDIT prepares students for successful careers in technology and innovation.

I am a proud alumnus of Prabhu Dayal Public School, where I received a well-rounded education focused on academic excellence, extracurricular activities, and personal development. The school played a key role in shaping my skills and values, which continue to influence my academic and professional growth.
